_notes: Hand-edited inputs for token_tracker.js (RULES.md §8). Everything else comes from MFL, KTC and data.json.
starting_balances: tokens each franchise carried into the season (Token Tracker sheet, Start of Year, 2026-01-15).
voided_trades / voided_waivers: no tokens (reverse, chained or conditional moves). Match on the MFL timestamp.
adjustments: tokens traded in trade comments, commish rulings, token draw results. tokens may be negative.
ktc_names: MFL player ID -> KTC spelling, for the older snapshots that have no MFL IDs.

voided_trades.reason: BattleBots used its right to swap 2026 5th-round picks with Peaky Fookin Blinders (conditional trade resolved 8/29); the sheet took the 2 tokens back from each team
